poem.title: 静夜思
poem.author: 李白
poem.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

user_prompt:

Title: 静夜思
Author: 李白
Genre: 五言绝句
Source:
床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。
translation:
**Quiet Night Thoughts**

Before my bed, the bright moonlight—
I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.
I lift my head and gaze at the bright moon;
I lower it and think of home.
